extraMeanings.en: an official who ensures rules are obeyed in a particular place
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The traffic warden gave me a ticket for parking on double yellow lines.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Trafik memuru çift sarı çizgiye park ettiğim için bana ceza kesti.

extraMeanings.en: an official document that gives the police permission to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The police obtained a warrant to search his house.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis, evini aramak için bir arama emri aldı.

extraMeanings.en: to become weak or tired, especially because of heat
extraMeanings.exampleEn: By the afternoon the runners were wilting in the heat.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonra koşucular sıcaktan bitkin düşüyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the amount of something, such as crops, that is produced
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This year's crop yield was much higher than expected.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu yılki ürün verimi beklenenden çok daha yüksekti.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: She painted the walls in vibrant shades of orange and red.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duvarları göz alıcı turuncu ve kırmızı tonlarında boyadı.

extraMeanings.en: (of ideas or humour) unpleasant or strange in a way that is not normal
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He has a warped sense of humour that many people find disturbing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Birçok kişinin rahatsız edici bulduğu çarpık bir mizah anlayışı var.

extraMeanings.en: to end up in a particular place or situation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: If he keeps spending like that, he'll wind up broke.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Böyle harcamaya devam ederse sonunda beş parasız kalacak.

extraMeanings.en: to deliberately tease or annoy someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Stop trying to wind me up, I know you're joking.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Beni kızdırmaya çalışmayı bırak, şaka yaptığını biliyorum.

extraMeanings.en: a place far from towns and civilization
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They live somewhere out in the wilds of northern Scotland.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kuzey İskoçya'nın ücra bir köşesinde yaşıyorlar.

extraMeanings.en: a total made up of smaller amounts, especially of scores
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team won 4-2 on aggregate over the two matches.

extraMeanings.tr: (anatomi) uzuv, organ çıkıntısı (kol, bacak, kuyruk vb.)
extraMeanings.en: a part of the body that sticks out, such as an arm, leg or tail
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The insect uses its long appendages to sense its surroundings.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Böcek, uzun uzuvlarını çevresini algılamak için kullanır.
